heading:
Reliable systems,
not clever ones.
bio: I am a second-year CSE student at NIT Patna, working across the stack. I build with TypeScript, React, Go, and Postgres, and I care about the parts that are easy to skip: error paths, latency, and code that stays readable after launch.
principle: Build small, reliable systems. Keep the interface quiet. Let the work hold up under real use.
